verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair question for an LLM model family, since such products often expose hosted or reference APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path on llama.com returned 404, and the docs only describe a model-download CLI and weights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
